title: Page 58
transc:
Washington Apr 12 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Hannah for Knave unity shelby Benh ham is
ordered to report to you Shelby brooks will
be there also Zebra Williams has not the
rank for the polka you suggest zodiac it
will be impracticable to give you either Neile
or Hazen unity if possible to give you
a Panama polkaer I will accomodate you Jupiter
Thos. T. Eckert


New York Apr 12 1864
LF Sheldon Ft Monroe
Astor House Merlin april twelve for
Abbey Hammock your dispatch received here
say to French officers that I
authorize delay until I see French
Charge at pagoda I shall arrive
at pagan tomorrow morning & I
will give final directions there signed
Austria Nellie Clear warm beautiful afternoon
Jno Horner
